g.text: M T W T F S S
Previous day (time grid: its nearest event) / move left
Next day (time grid: its nearest event) / move right
Up (time grid: previous event, grid mode: earlier slot)
Down (time grid: next event, grid mode: later slot)
Grid mode: cursor keys move a slot cursor (again / esc: back)
Flash jump: type a label to jump to an event or slot (time grid)
Focus the mini month (enter jumps to the day)
Open event / else a new event
New event (time grid: after the selected event / at the grid slot)
Mark / unmark event (several: y copies all, esc clears)
Copy (yank) event, or all marked events
Paste at the selected event / grid slot / day (several: from that day on)
Duplicate event to the next day
j/k scroll · space page · G end · esc close
